items.title: Stanley Kay interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clearwater Beach, Florida, March 18, 2001
items.q: I’ll get you the Buddy Rich band for nothing... and I’ll get you Mel Torme. But Mel gets paid. So Mel got five thousand, and it was very successful.

ctx.x: Oh God. He was quite a practical joker.
Oh yeah, oh forget it. He threw a pie in Mel Torme’s face while he was singing.
